case.summary: The alert was triggered by the customer's message that they never made the $30.02 online purchase (transaction 3581141). The strongest fraud finding is the customer's denial of the transaction, confirming they did not make the purchase, did not share card details, and still possess the card, together with a Vesta count of 24 on this transaction versus a median of 1 on the card. A legitimate indicator is that a similar amount ($29.97, product S) was previously charged on the same card on 2016-12-15. The case is judged fraud with a probability of 0.89. The recommended actions are to block the card and create a new case.
